description: MAOMAO is building an Asian food discovery platform around our online supermarket, combining e-commerce, content, community and social commerce. We help people discover new foods, brands, trends and cultures through TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, TikTok Shop, our online shop and our own products. We're looking for a Growth Manager (m/f/d) who wants to take real ownership of our next stage of growth: winning new customers, bringing existing customers back and turning ideas into measurable, profitable results. You'll work directly with the founders and our existing marketing and content team to decide where we focus, what we test and how we execute. Tasks What You'll Do Growth Strategy & Execution You will identify growth opportunities and turn them into clear priorities and actionable plans. This includes: defining measurable growth goals together with the founders identifying opportunities across customer acquisition, conversion, average order value and repeat purchases prioritizing initiatives based on expected impact, effort and cost developing experiments with clear responsibilities, timelines and success criteria reviewing results and deciding what to improve, scale or stop You'll connect commercial goals with everyday execution and keep projects moving. TikTok Shop & Social Commerce Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue growing. You will work on: TikTok Shop campaigns, promotions and Seller Center management livestream campaigns, formats and activations affiliate and creator collaborations product selection, offers and promotional planning coordination with TikTok and external partners identifying and testing new opportunities Experience with TikTok Shop is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity, commercial thinking and the ability to learn quickly matter. Campaigns, Content & Product Launches You will plan and coordinate campaigns, promotions and product launches from idea to execution. Together with our marketing and content team, you will help decide: which products, topics and offers we should focus on how we communicate them to our audience which content formats and channels make sense how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, our online shop and email how we turn audience interest into purchases You will create timelines, clarify responsibilities, identify dependencies early and follow through on deliverables. Customer Retention & CRM You will help give existing customers reasons to come back through: email campaigns and customer communication customer segmentation and relevant offers repeat-purchase and reactivation initiatives campaigns connecting product launches, community activities and retention You'll test different approaches and use the results to improve them. Performance, KPIs & Budgets You will use data to guide decisions and spending. This includes: tracking relevant business and campaign KPIs understanding which activities drive sales and at what cost evaluating results with margins, discounts, fees and campaign costs in mind managing agreed budgets and recommending how to allocate resources communicating results and next steps clearly You should be comfortable working with numbers, questioning assumptions and turning analysis into action. Team & Project Coordination You will work with our existing marketing and content team to turn priorities into execution. You will: clarify responsibilities, deadlines and expected outcomes keep track of projects and follow up on deliverables improve workflows and processes support team members with clear briefs and constructive feedback coordinate with purchasing and operations so campaigns match stock availability and fulfilment capacity Depending on your experience, you can take on team leadership from the start or grow into it as your responsibilities expand. What Ownership Means at MAOMAO Ownership means understanding the goal and thinking through what it takes to achieve it. If we're launching a product in four weeks, we want someone who asks: What are we trying to achieve? Who are we targeting? What's the offer? Which channels should we use? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked? You won't always have complete information. We value someone who makes informed decisions, proposes solutions and learns through testing. Not every idea will work. What matters is that we learn, adjust and keep moving. The mindset we're looking for is: “Here is the opportunity. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next — and how we'll measure it.” Requirements Who We're Looking For We're open to candidates from startups, consulting, banking, growth, e-commerce and digital marketing . You should: have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience bring strong analytical and commercial thinking have taken ownership of projects and be able to explain your contribution and results be highly organized, reliable and proactive turn ideas and analysis into structured plans and execution prioritize effectively when time and resources are limited communicate clearly, follow through and work well with others be comfortable working with data, KPIs and budgets be willing to experiment, make decisions and learn quickly have a strong interest in consumer businesses, e-commerce and social commerce be hands-on and enjoy working in a small, fast-moving team have fluent German skills (C1 or native-level) for our predominantly German-speaking audience have strong working proficiency in English Direct experience in TikTok Shop, livestreaming, affiliate marketing, CRM, performance marketing or campaign management is a plus. If you're coming from consulting or banking, we'd like to understand how you've taken a recommendation through to implementation, or otherwise demonstrated that you can get things done. Previous team leadership experience is welcome, but not essential. Chinese language skills are a plus, but not a requirement. We care more about how you think, take ownership and deliver results than the university you attended. You don't need to be an expert in every marketing channel. You do need to learn quickly, understand what matters and take responsibility for outcomes. Benefits What We Offer A central role with direct influence on MAOMAO's growth Direct collaboration with the founders, with backgrounds in venture capital and e-commerce An existing marketing and content team to work with An established business and active community to build on Our own office, warehouse and content setup in Berlin Short decision-making paths and the freedom to implement ideas Room to experiment with products, offers, content and new channels Work at the intersection of e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, livestreaming and brand building Responsibility for projects from the initial idea through to results Professional development and the potential to take on more leadership responsibility An international team with passion and team spirit Employee discount across our assortment Interested? Send us your CV and a short introduction explaining why you want to join MAOMAO and what excites you about this role. We'd also like you to answer one question: Tell us about a project, campaign or experiment you took ownership of. What was the goal, what did you personally do, what was the result, and what did you learn? Your example can come from marketing, a startup, consulting, banking or another relevant setting. It doesn't have to be a huge project or a perfect success. We're interested in your decisions, your contribution and how you approach problems. We don't mind if you use AI to help with your application — we use AI too. But if your application could be sent to 50 other companies by simply replacing the company name, it's probably not for us. Show us why MAOMAO, and show us how you think. If you want to take ownership, move fast and help us grow a category that has been treated as a niche for far too long, we'd love to hear from you. Maybe you're the Sriracha to our noodle soup. 🌶️🍜
title: Growth Manager (m/f/d)

description: About Omni Omni is the AI analytics platform that turns company data into a trusted source of truth for AI. Built on a semantic model, Omni gives teams a governed context graph, so everyone gets the same trusted answer. Ask in plain English, refine in workbooks, or bring your data into tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and Slack. Our team has spent decades building data platforms, and we started Omni to fix problems we saw firsthand. Today, we help customers like Condé Nast, BambooHR, and Synthesia get better answers from their data. We're headquartered in San Francisco and have raised $217M from top investors including ICONIQ, Theory Ventures, and Redpoint Ventures. Our latest $120M Series C valued us at $1.5B. If you like helping people get more from their data, come build with us. We’d love to hear from you. The Role We're looking for a Growth Manager to own field and account-based marketing across EMEA, building in-person and ABM programs that generate and accelerate pipeline. You'll plan and run the regional field calendar, partnering closely with sales, BDRs, and partnerships to reach target accounts at the right point in the buying cycle. You'll also work with the Global Events team on flagship events in the region. You'll be measured on the pipeline your programs drive. This role reports to the Head of Growth Marketing, EMEA. Responsibilities Own field and ABM pipeline. Generate and accelerate pipeline from field and account-based programs, and be accountable for field-sourced and influenced pipeline and the cost to produce it. Build and run the EMEA field calendar. Propose the quarterly field plan in line with the Head of Growth Marketing's priorities, then run each program end to end, from executive dinners and roundtables to partner events and conference activations. Run account-based programs with sales. Agree target accounts with sales and BDRs, build coordinated plays for them, and make sure every engaged account gets timely follow-up. Co-market with partners. Work with the partnerships team to find and run joint field programs with our technology and consulting partners. Manage the field budget. Allocate spend across programs within the EMEA growth budget, forecast the pipeline each program should return, and reallocate as results come in. Bring EMEA input to flagship events. Work with the Global Events team on major events in the region, contributing account targeting, sales input, and pre- and post-event follow-up. Measure and report on results. Track pipeline and ROI by program, report to the Head of Growth Marketing and regional sales leadership, and use the results to shape the next quarter's plan. About You 3+ years in B2B marketing focused on field marketing, events, or ABM, ideally at a SaaS company. A track record of running in-person programs across more than one market, from executive dinners to large conference presences, with pipeline results you can point to. Experience running account-based programs jointly with sales and BDR teams, with results you can walk us through. Experience managing a program budget, including tracking spend, knowing your cost per meeting or opportunity, and flagging over- or under-pacing early. Hands-on with CRM and marketing automation, and comfortable building your own program reporting and pipeline attribution. Experience running several programs at once, handling planning, invitations, on-site delivery, and follow-up yourself. Ability to travel up to 25% of the time. Nice to Haves Experience marketing to data, analytics, or engineering buyers (BI, data infrastructure, or developer tools). Experience running co-marketing programs with technology or consulting partners. Professional working proficiency in French or German. Location This is a hybrid role based in Dublin, with 3 days per week in-office. Why Join Us Passionate, supportive team with extensive experience in the space (including founders from Looker and Stitch Data) all working together to win as a team Health insurance through Irish Life Cycle to work scheme Equity Flexible PTO Omni is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every single box. Please, let us know if you need any reasonable accommodations during the interview process.

description: The Firm A leading professional services firm undergoing an ambitious technology transformation programme, focused on modernising digital platforms, improving business processes and advancing their customer offering. As part of this transformation, there is significant investment in technology capabilities, strengthening product led approach and delivering innovative digital solutions that create lasting business value. Your role A Digital Product Owner for Digital Services, you will support the Lead Product Owner in shaping, delivering and continuously improving the Firm’s digital products and services (website, channels, platforms, events). You will take ownership of a defined product backlog, ensuring priorities are aligned with business needs, strategic objectives and delivery capacity including CRM / Salesforce. Acting as the link between business stakeholders and technology teams, you will translate requirements into clear, actionable deliverables and drive solutions that improve user experience, operational efficiency and business performance. This is a hands-on product ownership role requiring strong stakeholder management, confident prioritisation and the ability to balance strategic initiatives, business-as-usual activity, technical improvements and risk reduction. What you'll be doing Support the Lead Product Owner in defining and delivering the product strategy and roadmap for assigned digital products and services. Own and manage product backlogs, ensuring priorities reflect business value, user needs, strategic goals and delivery capacity. Work closely with Business Owners and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria. Make informed prioritisation decisions, balancing competing demands across strategic initiatives, business-as-usual enhancements, technical debt and risk requirements. Collaborate with Business Analysts, developers, architects, service teams and third-party suppliers to ensure effective delivery. Actively participate in agile delivery activities, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and acceptance of completed work. Support the full product lifecycle, from discovery and development through to implementation and transition into live service. Build strong stakeholder relationships, providing clear communication on product priorities, progress, risks and delivery trade-offs. Work with Service Owners to monitor product performance, user feedback and service data, identifying opportunities for optimisation and continuous improvement. Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve user experience and deliver measurable business value through digital solutions. Ensure products align with the Firm's technology strategy, governance requirements and enterprise architecture standards. Champion product management best practice, promoting collaboration, transparency and value-driven delivery. About you Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Business Analyst with hands-on product ownership responsibilities. Strong experience of managing and refining product backlogs, writing user stories and acceptance criteria, and working within agile delivery teams. Demonstrable ability to manage senior stakeholders, challenge requirements and make prioritisation decisions under competing pressures. Experience of managing multiple products, workstreams or priorities across strategic delivery, business-as-usual activity and technical improvements. Strong understanding of agile methodologies and the end-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery through to live service. Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across business and technology teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a pragmatic approach to balancing business value, user needs and technical considerations. Experience of collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers, architects, Business Analysts and third-party suppliers. A proactive, delivery-focused mindset with a commitment to continuous improvement and delivering measurable outcomes. Desirable experience Experience with Salesforce or similar enterprise CRM and digital platforms. Exposure to enterprise applications, digital services, workflow automation or business process improvement. Experience working in professional services, financial services or complex international organisations. Familiarity with agile delivery tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps. Experience working with external technology partners or implementation suppliers. What success looks like You will bring clarity and ownership to product priorities, build trusted stakeholder relationships and ensure delivery teams focus on the work that creates the greatest business value. You will be confident navigating competing demands, making informed trade-offs and driving continuous improvement across the Firm's digital services portfolio.

The Business Analyst is responsible for analysing business processes, gathering and documenting requirements, managing stakeholder engagement, and supporting projects throughout their full lifecycle. Engage with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements, assess existing processes, and identify opportunities for business improvement. Facilitate requirements-gathering activities, including workshops, stakeholder discussions, and other appropriate analysis techniques. Work collaboratively with technical teams and external suppliers to ensure business requirements are clearly understood and translated into effective solutions. Project Delivery and Stakeholder Engagement Support the planning, coordination, and delivery of ICT-enabled projects and business change initiatives throughout the project lifecycle. Work with stakeholders across business and technical teams to ensure project requirements, objectives, and expected outcomes are clearly defined. Process Improvement and Business Change Analyse existing business processes to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Experience in process improvement and business process re-engineering.

Key Responsibilities: • Requirements Elicitation and Analysis: ◦ Conduct in-depth interviews, workshops, surveys, and other techniques to gather, analyze, and validate business requirements from diverse stakeholders. ◦ Translate high-level business needs into detailed functional and non-functional requirements, user stories, use cases, and process flows. ◦ Analyze existing business processes value. ◦ Provide training and support to end-users as needed. • Process Improvement and Data Analysis: ◦ Continuously identify opportunities for process improvement and suggest innovative solutions. ◦ Utilize data analysis techniques to derive actionable insights from various data sources. ◦ Develop and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure project success and business impact. • 2-5 business analysis methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall). • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills. • Exceptional communication (written and verbal), presentation, and interpersonal skills. • Proficiency in creating clear and concise documentation. • Experience with project management principles and tools. • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint), Confluence, Jira. • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

description: About Rippling Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. You will manage a multi-million dollar annual budget and own the growth strategy across channels such as Paid Social, SEM, SEO, Affiliate, and Email. We’re looking for someone who goes beyond channel execution and finds pockets of gold in the database and regularly thinks up new automations that double the team’s output. This is a Senior, team lead position. You should have people management experience and a proven ability to build a high performing team. We’re looking for someone who can motivate people to do the best work of their careers, whether they’re a direct report or a cross functional collaborator. You'll have a very close partnership with the regional Sales teams as well as our centralised marketing, regional demand generation, operations, and analytics teams (among others) in order to efficiently drive revenue. You should have demonstrated experience of successful Sales and Marketing alignment across multiple markets and languages. Hamid, a partner at Kleiner Perkins, recently said that "Rippling's growth is in the 1% of the 1%. At their scale, they are one of the fastest growing companies in the world." As a member of our growth team, you'll own the end-to-end performance of your channels, diligently optimising while also exploring new and creative ways to inflect growth. What You Will Do Manage a 7-figure annual budget efficiently Develop channel strategy by understanding our products, buyer pain points, and channel dynamics across each focus country within EMEA Be responsible for accurate localisation and in-language marketing execution for France, Germany and Spain, plus any additional languages we add later Own and execute the plan for scaling growth from paid channels (SEM, Meta, LinkedIn, Affiliates), email, and others to expand our reach across EMEA Build experimentation roadmaps grounded in sound hypotheses and scale what works Improve campaign efficiency by concepting more resonant creative / graphics tailored to target audiences and regional nuance Build smart AI-powered database workflows to derive more from our existing prospect and customer database Improve qualification processes and test technological innovations to improve lead quality Build and manage relationships. You'll need to partner closely with our regional Sales teams Analyse data to understand what's working and what's not — from reading through replies to writing SQL and hopping into Excel Proactively share insights and wins across the marketing team. You will find successful campaigns/tactics that Rippling rolls out across the entire organisation What You Will Need 8+ years experience driving growth in a fast-paced environment 2+ years in a team lead or people management position German and English language fluency Strong ownership mindset: motivated by the idea of owning a number, and are not afraid to step up to big challenges. You have a growth mindset and readily look for feedback on how to improve Cross-functional communicator: you communicate proactively and effectively, marshaling internal resources and external partners to keep operations running smoothly Stellar written and verbal communication skills in both English and German. Spanish or French is a bonus An eye for good email & ad copy in both languages, and know how to get in the heads of our prospects Bias to action: You'll constantly try new growth ideas in this role; you have a bias to action and learning and will do whatever it takes to get your projects over the finish line Structured, data-driven problem-solving: you are able to analyse and design solutions to ambiguous problems in ambiguous environments. You have the ability to analyse data to uncover insights in order to optimise performance towards your goals Inbox 0 mindset: You have the ability to prioritise tasks effectively and handle multiple projects and timelines, ensuring everything is delivered on time and within scope Hackiness and creativity: You're constantly generating new ideas and are eager to experiment Nice to haves: French or Spanish speaker, experience with the EMEA market, experience in a B2B environment

description: As a Digital Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for driving customer acquisition, engagement, and revenue growth across international markets through data-driven digital marketing strategies. This role combines hands-on campaign management, conversion rate optimization, advanced tracking and analytics, and cross-functional collaboration to maximize marketing performance. The ideal candidate will leverage expertise in paid and organic channels, marketing technology, and analytics platforms to deliver measurable business outcomes while continuously optimizing the customer journey Key Responsibilities 1. Campaign Execution & Optimization Launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok Apply structured testing, refine targeting, and adjust bidding strategies to improve efficiency and scale results. Implement acquisition and retention tactics that drive measurable performance. 2. Conversion Optimization & Testing Analyze conversion paths to identify friction points and opportunities for improvement. Execute A/B and multivariate tests across ads, audiences, and landing pages. Maintain a clear CRO roadmap with regular performance updates. 3. Tracking Infrastructure & Data Management Manage GTM for tagging, tracking, remarketing, and conversion events across all channels. Ensure data accuracy, proper attribution, and seamless integration with CRM and offline conversion tracking systems. Maintain clean data structures to support reliable analysis and forecasting. 4. Insights Development & Reporting Build reporting dashboards that highlight key performance indicators across paid and organic channels. Translate data into insights that guide optimization decisions and strategic recommendations. Monitor trends, diagnose performance shifts, and provide proactive insights to stakeholders. 5. Cross-Functional Alignment Collaborate with internal teams to ensure consistent messaging, accurate data flow, and smooth campaign execution. Present findings, learnings, and next steps to leadership and cross-functional partners in a clear and actionable format. Requirements Experience: Minimum 6 years in performance marketing in international markets. Technical Expertise: Advanced in Google Tag Manager (GTM) and Google Analytics (GA4). Skilled at campaign optimization for performance marketing and conversion rate optimization. Successfully passed the exams for Google search ads, Google measurement, Meta and LinkedIn certifications Familiarity with offline conversion tracking and CRM integration. Core Competencies: Strong digital marketing skills for both organic and paid channels. Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. Commercial mindset with hands-on campaign execution capability. Strong problem-solving abilities and collaboration skills. Excellent communication skills must be fluent in English. Preferred Competencies: Experienced in managing CRM & email marketing campaigns. Great understanding of AI’s impact on digital marketing.
